EXPLORER 1

6–9 months: animals, objects and thinking together.

The Explorer 1 class. Around this age babies recognise familiar pictures, love animal sounds and start to remember what they have seen, so this lesson pairs animals and everyday objects with simple naming and sound play.

Age 6–9 MonthsClass Explorer 1Subjects Talk, thinking, recognition
Lesson 5Talk & Think

Animals & Everyday Objects

Realistic animals alongside a ball, a shoe, a cup and more — name them, add the sounds, and let early recognition grow. Three to five playful minutes.
